summary: feat(settings): add unified footer behind the unifiedFooter flag
description:
Because:

* FxA settings has three different footers on its pages.
* One footer for all pages must ship behind a flag first.

This commit:

* Adds the unifiedFooter feature flag, off by default
* Adds a Footer with links and a language and theme panel
* Uses it in SettingsLayout and AppLayout when the flag is on
* Adds the sun, night-mode and device-desktop nova icons

Closes FXA-15123
